teaser: The FCA plans a framework for agentic finance. Our open behaviour policies cover its four elements; a vault shows six bank agents at play.
core_idea: The FCA's planned framework for agentic finance, with agent identity, delegated authority, accountability and execution, lines up with open work already published here; a vault of six invented bank agents shows all four filled in and at play, where rows kept by boundaries held and every incident came through a gap, and a regulator could adopt the work or connect its own graph to it.
